points.title: 出生地
points.description: 郦道元出生于北魏范阳（今河北涿州），这里是他的出生地，也是他早年生活的地点。在这里，他接受了初步的教育，为他后来的学术成就打下了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Li Dao Yuan was born in Fanyang (modern Zhuzhou, Hebei), which was his place of birth and early residence. Here, he received his initial education, laying the foundation for his later academic achievements.

points.title: 任职北魏朝廷
points.titleEn: Service in the Northern Wei Court
points.description: 郦道元在北魏朝廷任职，期间参与了《水经注》的编纂工作。这部著作是中国古代地理学的重要文献，对后世地理学的发展产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: Li Dao Yuan served in the Northern Wei court, during which he participated in the compilation of the 'Comprehensive Treatise on Waterways'. This work is an important document in ancient Chinese geography and has had a profound impact on the development of geography in later generations.

points.title: 任关中镇将
points.description: 郦道元被任命为关中镇将，负责关中的军事和行政事务。在此期间，他继续对地理学的研究，并完成了《水经注》的修订工作。
points.descriptionEn: Li Dao Yuan was appointed as the Commander of Guanzhong, responsible for military and administrative affairs in Guanzhong. During this period, he continued his research in geography and completed the revision of the 'Comprehensive Treatise on Waterways'.

supporter.zh: 郦道元被誉为中国古代地理学的奠基人之一，他的《水经注》是中国地理学史上的一部巨著，对后世地理学的发展产生了深远影响。
supporter.en: Li Dao Yuan is hailed as one of the founders of ancient Chinese geography. His 'Comprehensive Treatise on Waterways' is a monumental work in the history of Chinese geography, which has had a profound impact on the development of geography in later generations.

critic.zh: 一些学者认为，郦道元的《水经注》虽然详实，但在某些方面也存在不足，如对地理现象的解释不够深入。
critic.en: Some scholars believe that while Li Dao Yuan's 'Comprehensive Treatise on Waterways' is detailed, it also has shortcomings in certain aspects, such as insufficient in-depth explanations of geographical phenomena.

objective.zh: 郦道元在地理学上的贡献被广泛认可，但他的政治生涯也充满争议。他在北魏朝廷的任职期间，曾因政治斗争而受到排挤。
objective.en: Li Dao Yuan's contribution to geography is widely recognized, but his political career was also controversial. During his service in the Northern Wei court, he was marginalized due to political struggles.

self.en: Water is the blood of the earth.

others.zh: 郦道元之《水经注》，实为地理学之宝。
others.en: Li Dao Yuan's 'Comprehensive Treatise on Waterways' is truly a treasure of geography.
